sources.citation: Samaniego, Lorenzo, Enrique Vergara, and Henning Bischof. 1985. "New Evidence on Cerro Sechín, Casma Valley, Peru." In Early Ceremonial Architecture in the Andes: A Conference at Dumbarton Oaks, 8th to 10th October 1982, edited by Christopher B. Donnan, 165–190. Washington, DC: Dumbarton Oaks Research Library and Collection.
sources.notes: Primary chapter on Cerro Sechín architecture, carved stones, paintings, and revised chronology from stratigraphy and radiocarbon/TL. Historical methods; cross-check absolute dates with later work.

sources.citation: Pozorski, Shelia, and Thomas Pozorski. 1992. "Early Civilization in the Casma Valley, Peru." Antiquity 66 (253): 845–870. https://doi.org/10.1017/S0003598X00044781
sources.notes: Peer-reviewed synthesis of Initial Period monumental centers in Casma (incl. Sechín Alto complex). Civilization/state framing is authors' model — not a global ranking here.

sources.citation: Burger, Richard L., and Lucy Salazar-Burger. 1985. "The Early Ceremonial Center of Huaricoto." In Early Ceremonial Architecture in the Andes, edited by Christopher B. Donnan, 111–138. Washington, DC: Dumbarton Oaks.
sources.notes: Primary report on Huaricoto (Callejón de Huaylas) Kotosh–Mito-style hearth structures; highland comparative. Do not collapse highland and coastal polities.

sources.citation: Izumi, Seiichi, and Toshihiko Sono. 1963. Andes 2: Excavations at Kotosh, Peru, 1960. Tokyo: University of Tokyo / Kadokawa Publishing Co.
sources.notes: Primary University of Tokyo report on the 1960 Kotosh season (Andes 2). Temple of the Crossed Hands sequence anchors Kotosh-tradition discussion.

sources.citation: Izumi, Seiichi, and Kazuo Terada, eds. 1972. Andes 4: Excavations at Kotosh, Peru, 1963 and 1966. Tokyo: University of Tokyo Press.
sources.notes: Primary report on 1963 and 1966 Kotosh seasons (Andes 4). Cite for published architecture/strata, not invented inventories.

sources.citation: Sandweiss, Daniel H., Heather McInnis, Richard L. Burger, Asunción Cano, Bernardino Ojeda, Rolando Paredes, María del Carmen Sandweiss, and Michael D. Glascock. 1998. "Quebrada Jaguay: Early South American Maritime Adaptations." Science 281 (5384): 1830–1832. https://doi.org/10.1126/science.281.5384.1830
sources.notes: Primary Science report on Terminal Pleistocene / early Holocene maritime economy at Quebrada Jaguay (QJ-280). Comparative — outside Norte Chico core.

sources.citation: Keefer, David K., Susan D. deFrance, Michael E. Moseley, James B. Richardson III, Dennis R. Satterlee, and Amy Day-Lewis. 1998. "Early Maritime Economy and El Niño Events at Quebrada Tacahuay, Peru." Science 281 (5384): 1833–1835. https://doi.org/10.1126/science.281.5384.1833
sources.notes: Primary Science report on early maritime economy and El Niño burial of deposits at Quebrada Tacahuay. Comparative far-south coastal site.

sources.citation: Dillehay, Tom D. 1997. Monte Verde: A Late Pleistocene Settlement in Chile. Volume 2: The Archaeological Context and Interpretation. Smithsonian Series in Archaeological Inquiry. Washington, DC: Smithsonian Institution Press.
sources.notes: Primary final-report volume on Monte Verde (southern Chile). Comparative Late Pleistocene settlement — do not relocate into Norte Chico chronology.

sources.citation: Pozorski, Shelia, and Thomas Pozorski. 2011. "The Square-Room Unit as an Emblem of Power and Authority in the Initial Period Sechín Alto Polity, Casma Valley, Peru." Latin American Antiquity 22 (4): 427–451.
sources.notes: Peer-reviewed architecture paper on square-room units in the Sechín Alto Initial Period complex. Polity/power-emblem reading is authors' interpretation.

sources.citation: Donnan, Christopher B., ed. 1985. Early Ceremonial Architecture in the Andes: A Conference at Dumbarton Oaks, 8th to 10th October 1982. Washington, DC: Dumbarton Oaks Research Library and Collection. ISBN 0-88402-135-1.
sources.notes: Edited conference volume consolidating early Andean ceremonial-architecture research (container for Samaniego/Burger chapters).

sites.szh: 东京大学发掘的山间礼仪中心；十字交叉手神庙序列为科托什传统讨论锚点。
sites.sen: Highland ceremonial center excavated by University of Tokyo; Temple of the Crossed Hands sequence anchors Kotosh-tradition discussion.

sites.szh: Burger & Salazar-Burger 报告的山间早期礼仪中心；Kotosh–Mito 式中心火塘建筑。
sites.sen: Highland early ceremonial center with Kotosh–Mito-style central-hearth structures (Burger & Salazar-Burger).

sites.kind: Initial Period mound/plaza in Sechín Alto cluster
sites.szh: 塞钦阿尔托复合体组成部分；与潘帕德拉斯拉马斯–莫塞克等有建筑/器物可比性（Pozorski）。
sites.sen: Component of the Sechín Alto complex; architectural/artifact parallels noted by Pozorski.

sites.szh: 卡斯马海岸初始期大址；Pozorski 综合中作为河谷—海岸系统节点讨论。
sites.sen: Coastal Initial Period center in Pozorski Casma settlement/subsistence syntheses.

sites.kind: Terminal Pleistocene / early Holocene maritime camp
sites.szh: Sandweiss 等 1998 Science：终末更新世/早全新世海洋适应；远离北奇科核心。
sites.sen: Sandweiss et al. 1998 Science: Terminal Pleistocene / early Holocene maritime adaptations; outside Norte Chico core.

sites.kind: Early maritime economy / El Niño-sealed deposits
sites.szh: Keefer 等 1998 Science：早期海洋经济与厄尔尼诺埋藏层；比较性南岸遗址。
sites.sen: Keefer et al. 1998 Science: early maritime economy and El Niño-sealed deposits; comparative south-coast site.

sites.szh: Dillehay 最终报告卷二：晚更新世定居；仅作比较，不并入北奇科年代。
sites.sen: Dillehay final-report vol. 2: Late Pleistocene settlement; comparative only — not folded into Norte Chico chronology.

asms.zh: 科托什十字交叉手神庙组合
asms.en: Kotosh Temple of the Crossed Hands assemblage
asms.szh: 东京大学报告中的礼仪建筑与泥塑浮雕组合（组合级）。
asms.sen: Ceremonial architecture and modeled reliefs as published in University of Tokyo reports (assemblage-level).

asms.zh: 瓦里科托 Mito 火塘礼仪组合
asms.szh: 中心火塘、分阶地面、壁龛等 Kotosh–Mito 式结构类别。
asms.sen: Central-hearth, split-level floors, and niche classes of Kotosh–Mito-style structures.

asms.zh: 塞钦山石雕与建筑组合（Samaniego 1985）
asms.en: Cerro Sechín carved-stone and architecture assemblage (Samaniego 1985)
asms.szh: 中心建筑、石雕与彩绘类别；年代修订依地层与测年样本。
asms.sen: Central building, stone carvings, and painted decoration classes; chronology revised from strata and dated samples.

asms.zh: 陶卡奇-孔坎方形房间单位组合
asms.szh: 与潘帕德拉斯拉马斯–莫塞克 Huaca A 模块可比的矩形房间单位。
asms.sen: Rectangular room units comparable to modular construction at Pampa de las Llamas–Moxeke Huaca A.

asms.zh: 哈瓜伊干谷海洋适应组合
asms.szh: 终末更新世/早全新世海洋资源利用与石器组合（Science 1998）。
asms.sen: Terminal Pleistocene / early Holocene maritime resource use and lithic assemblage (Science 1998).

asms.zh: 塔卡瓦伊干谷海洋经济组合
asms.szh: 早期海洋经济与厄尔尼诺相关埋藏层（Science 1998）。
asms.sen: Early maritime economy and El Niño-related sealed deposits (Science 1998).

asms.zh: 蒙特维德晚更新世定居组合
asms.en: Monte Verde Late Pleistocene settlement assemblage
asms.szh: Dillehay 卷二所综合的居住与木构等发现类别（组合级）。
asms.sen: Habitation and wooden-architecture find classes as synthesized in Dillehay vol. 2 (assemblage-level).

asms.zh: 拉斯哈尔达斯初始期组合
asms.szh: 卡斯马海岸初始期纪念性/居住组合（Pozorski 综合）。
asms.sen: Coastal Initial Period monumental/residential assemblage classes (Pozorski syntheses).

claims.zh: 东京大学《安第斯》2/4 报告科托什 1960/1963/1966 季发掘结果（礼仪建筑序列）。
claims.en: University of Tokyo Andes 2/4 reports publish Kotosh 1960/1963/1966 excavation results (ceremonial architecture sequence).

claims.zh: Burger & Salazar-Burger（1985）报告瓦里科托存在 Kotosh–Mito 式中心火塘礼仪建筑。
claims.en: Burger & Salazar-Burger (1985) report Kotosh–Mito-style central-hearth ceremonial architecture at Huaricoto.

claims.zh: Samaniego 等（1985）公布塞钦山中心建筑、石雕与彩绘，并据地层与测年修订年代。
claims.en: Samaniego et al. (1985) publish Cerro Sechín central architecture, carvings, and paintings, revising chronology from strata and dates.

claims.zh: Pozorski & Pozorski（1992）在 Antiquity 综合卡斯马河谷初始期纪念性中心（含塞钦阿尔托复合体）。
claims.en: Pozorski & Pozorski (1992) synthesize Initial Period monumental centers of the Casma Valley (incl. Sechín Alto complex) in Antiquity.

claims.zh: Sandweiss 等（1998）报告哈瓜伊干谷终末更新世/早全新世海洋适应证据。
claims.en: Sandweiss et al. (1998) report Terminal Pleistocene / early Holocene maritime adaptations at Quebrada Jaguay.

claims.zh: Keefer 等（1998）报告塔卡瓦伊干谷早期海洋经济与厄尔尼诺相关埋藏。
claims.en: Keefer et al. (1998) report early maritime economy and El Niño-related burial of deposits at Quebrada Tacahuay.

claims.zh: Dillehay（1997）卷二综合蒙特维德晚更新世考古语境与解释。
claims.en: Dillehay (1997) vol. 2 synthesizes Monte Verde Late Pleistocene archaeological context and interpretation.

claims.zh: 卡斯马塞钦阿尔托复合体代表安第斯「最早国家」——此为 Pozorski 等学术模型，不作定论。
claims.en: That the Casma Sechín Alto complex represents an "earliest Andean state" is a Pozorski et al. scholarly model — not a fact verdict here.
claims.disclaimer: Hypothesis: state / earliest-polity rankings remain debated; keep in hypothesis column.

claims.zh: 方形房间单位为塞钦阿尔托政体权力徽识——属作者解释，不作唯一政治定论。
claims.en: That square-room units are emblems of Sechín Alto polity power is the authors' interpretation, not a sole political verdict.
claims.disclaimer: Hypothesis: architectural emblem → polity power mapping is interpretive.
